remarks: Prime Location! Move-in ready apartment featuring an open-concept ranch-style layout. Enjoy a spacious kitchen, 1 bedroom, plus an additional office that can easily serve as a second bedroom. Just minutes from restaurants, shops, the library, and the train station. Relax on the large deck and take advantage of the private driveway for convenient tenant parking.  Oil Heating is included in rental. If tenant desires extra heating, the electric heating system is at tenant expense paid through tenant electric bill.  Tenant parking is located in the small driveway on the left. To access the apartment, please walk around to the long driveway on the right side of the house-do not walk across the lawn. The staircase to the apartment is at the rear of the house.
